Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do the teachings of Enlightened Beings contribute to uplifting society today?
2. Why is it important to adopt values drawn from the lives of Enlightened Beings?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Enlightened Beings Lord Krishna, Lord Buddha, Tirthankar Neminath, the honour of means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the values taught by the Enlightened Beings.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
